titles.title: six stage sections in workflow order hold every story and issue exactly once, in the column the snapshot assigns
with an epic scope and a search, cards, hidden counts, column totals and totals agree, and clearing both restores the full set
the same snapshot and filters give an identical model, including items with equal timestamps
unknownStages counts every stage id outside the six, and those items are in no column
an approved build with failed tasks stays in Complete and carries a text-labelled validation-conflict badge
a review-blocked design shows a Review blocked badge, matches Needs attention and keeps its column
a failed story-level result shows Validation failed, badges never repeat a label, and the accessible label names every badge
selectMatches returns the board's matches in snapshot order, each with its epic and card

compactId is 'ABCDEF01 / S001' for 'E20261009abcdef01:S001', 'ABCDEF01' for an epic-level 'E20261009abcdef01', 'ABCDEF01 / S002' for the H-form 'Habcdef0123456789:S002', and the full id for a ':R(<raw>)' fallback id
taskSummary is 'n/N tasks passed' from validation and null when validation is null or has no recorded tasks
accessibleLabel carries the compactId and task summary, and badges are unchanged
an approval state or review verdict this build does not know shows its code, ranks worst and is neutral, with no undefined label
stage sections start open when they hold matches, closed when empty, and Complete closed with its attention hint unless Needs attention is on
totals read N items · M need attention, or M of N with Show all under Needs attention, and empty stages fold under Needs attention
idParts reads the hash and story number of a published id, and nothing from any other id
sectionDefaults and foldOf give the board screens' existing section models
an epic with five stories, two complete, reads 2 of 5 stories complete, and every epic is a row in snapshot order
a standalone issue correcting a story of an epic counts towards no epic, and the epic's Epics row equals its board header
the Epics body filters rows by epic title or id and by attention, with whole-epic counts, and a search matching no epic gives the no-matches panel
epic rows count the planned tasks of the epic's stories and an issue's count separately
attentionLabel is 'No open gates' at 0, '1 needs attention' at 1, 'N need attention' otherwise
an epic row's compactId is the epic's compact id
the Issues body lists issues in stage order with their parent, parent notice and fix stories
with a search and a scope, the Issues list holds the same issues as the board screen
the Issues body groups issues into stage sections with the board screens' defaults and fold

titles.title: opening the board creates one editor-tab panel with a CSP-locked document and posts the snapshot's items with its taken-at time
when the earlier refresh answers after the later one, only the later snapshot is posted
a client that throws synchronously ends the refresh as failed instead of leaving the board loading
an answer or timeout that arrives after the panel is closed is neither posted nor logged
the board document inserts text only through textContent and posts only board up-messages
show-more reveals the next page of one stage, and a new search resets paging
an item with an unknown stage is left off the board and logged once per refresh
a filter change that cannot be rendered keeps the previous board and is logged
a refresh whose loading state cannot be shown is logged and asks the daemon nothing
a logger that throws never leaves the board loading or stops a refresh
opening a story reads its plan once per snapshot and shows the dependencies when it arrives
a review-view record opens in the review pane and a build record opens read-only from the daemon as text
a failed, malformed or stale plan read leaves the details standing with a notice
a filter change, Back and announcements: screen changes are announced once, a settled refresh once, and filters, density and reloads say nothing
clear-filters clears the screen's search and attention, keeps the screen, and resets paging
opening an epic and then a story replaces #main each time, and nothing from an earlier screen remains
the filter bar has exactly the four views and Needs attention, and no epic is a chip
an Epics row opens that epic's board with its header, breadcrumb and ← Epics, and no view control
stages render as six <details> sections in workflow order, and a toggled section stays as the reader left it across a refresh
a narrow pane shortens the breadcrumb and folds empty stages into Other stages · 0 matching, and widening re-renders the wide form
Back restores the saved scroll and focuses the card that opened the story; Escape goes back
empty replaces the screen, no matches replaces the list area with Clear filters, and a failed refresh over a story keeps the story under the banner
CSP string unchanged, exactly one aria-live region, and the script uses textContent only and posts only BoardUpMessage envelopes
opening a story replaces the screen: #main holds only the story screen, with its breadcrumb and Back, and no card from the list it came from
the story tabs post set-item-tab; overview shows the conflict first, tasks, why and chain; evidence is a records table with open buttons
linked work lists the epic, children and correcting issues, each opening its own screen
the issue screen opens what it corrects, or shows the parent notice, and lists its fix stories
density is restored from the webview state, saved on change and mirrored to the host, and both densities render every screen
the refresh announcement text is unchanged after statusView takes now
BOARD_STYLE carries the mocks' product rules with theme colours and no hiding rule
the narrow layout applies the mocks' container rules to the body
a refresh timing that cannot be measured says so in the log instead of reading as instant
an intent that changes nothing posts nothing
